module: Entry point of career mode. It activates and deactivates the career: loads the level (west_coast_usa by default, or the one from the save), loads all modules in lua/ge/extensions/career/modules/ (except /tutorial/step), blocks certain input actions (vehicleTeleporting, vehicleMenues, physicsControls, aiControls…), shows an imgui debug menu, handles the starting modes (startingModes), the starter vehicle, interactions with organizations, the profile/save list sent to the UI and the saving of general.json (level, starting options, boughtStarterVehicle, organizationInteraction).
usage:
career_career.createOrLoadCareerAndStart('myProfile', nil, {startMode = 'apmOnboarding'})
if career_career.isActive() then print(career_career.getBeamXPLevel(250)) end
notes: Activation: activateCareer requests the loading screen, emits the hook onBeforeCareerActivate, reads <save>/career/general.json; if the current level differs, launches freeroam_freeroam.startFreeroam and loads the modules at the end; otherwise removes the vehicles (core_vehicles.removeAll, or only those outside traffic/parking if removeVehicles is false) then emits onCareerActive(true, newSave).
Deactivation: onCareerActive(false) is emitted to all modules (27 listen to it) and the input actions are unblocked.
Tutorial: M.tutorialEnabled is true if startingOptions.startMode == "apmOnboarding" and the starter vehicle has not been bought yet; autosave is then disabled.
Bug: in toggleCareerModules, the call extensions.luaPathToExtName(modulePath) uses an undefined variable modulePath (nil) and its result is ignored.
deactivateCareer and deactivateCareerAndReloadLevel accept saveCareer but do not use it.
The debug menu (imgui) only exists if debugMenuEnabled, true by default outside the shipping_build version; it is linked to M.onUpdate only while the career is active.
onSerialize deactivates the career and notes reactivate = true; onDeserialized reactivates it with removeVehicles = false (useful during a reload of the Lua extensions).
onLoadingScreenFadeout navigates to "play" only once after an activation with a level load (flag playNavigationPendingAfterActivation).
onClientEndMission deactivates the career if the level that is ending is west_coast_usa.

tutorialEnabled.desc: True during the career tutorial (see notes).

startingOptions.desc: Starting options of the game (e.g. startMode), coming from createOrLoadCareerAndStart or from the save.

activateCareer.desc: Activates the career for the current profile (career_saveSystem.getCurrentProfile): no effect if already active or without a profile. Loads the level and the modules (see notes).

removeVehicles.desc: Remove all vehicles from the already loaded level; true by default.

deactivateCareer.desc: Deactivates the career: unloads the modules, unblocks the actions, resets the freeroam recovery values and hides the task list.

deactivateCareerAndReloadLevel.desc: Deactivates the career then restarts the current level in freeroam.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether the career is active.

createOrLoadCareerAndStart.desc: Selects (or creates) a save profile with career_saveSystem.setProfile then activates the career with the given starting options.

specificAutosave.desc: Name of a specific autosave to load.

returns.desc: false if the profile could not be selected.

getStartingModeOptions.desc: Lists the starting modes (*.lua files of lua/ge/extensions/career/startingModes/ run by dofile, except those with ignore) and returns for the UI: id, order, tier, title, description, image, tag, sorted by order then id.

getCurrentStartingModeData.desc: Returns the full definition of the current game's starting mode (startingOptions.startMode), or nil.

getBeamXPLevel.desc: Computes the BeamXP level: thresholds 0, 100, 300, 600, 1000. Returns -1 for the progress values if there is no next level.

returns.desc: Progress within the current level (-1 at the maximum).
Threshold required for the next level (-1 at the maximum).

sendAllCareerProfilesData.desc: Builds the info of each profile (money, beamXP, vouchers, insurance score, "apm" branches, current vehicle, vehicle count, versions) and sends it to the UI via guihooks "allCareerProfiles"; sorts by creationDate.

sendCurrentProfileData.desc: Returns the info of the current profile (same format as a profile from sendAllCareerProfilesData). Nil if the career is not active.

getAutosavesForProfile.desc: For each save folder of the profile, returns the content of playerAttributes.json with id and autosaveName.

getSaveFoldersForProfile.desc: Returns the list of a profile's save folders with what the UI needs to choose (name, dates, version, corrupted, isCurrent, incompatibleVersion, outdatedVersion, money, beamXP, vehicleCount), sorted from newest to oldest.

profile.desc: Profile name; empty list if nil.

hasBoughtStarterVehicle.desc: Indicates whether the player has bought their starter vehicle.

hasInteractedWithOrganization.desc: Indicates whether the player has already interacted with an organization.

interactWithOrganization.desc: Notes that the player has interacted with an organization (saved in general.json).

closeAllMenus.desc: Closes the menus by navigating to the "play" screen.

getAdditionalMenuButtons.desc: Buttons added to the pause menu: map (or "my load" during delivery), progress (if the starter vehicle is bought and outside the tutorial), certification cancellation, road test cancellation.

setDebugMenuEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the career's imgui debug menu.

onCareerActive.desc: onCareerActive hook received by this module itself (emitted by initAfterLevelLoad and deactivateCareer). On activation: applies the career or tutorial recovery values, clears the task list and raw POIs, installs M.onUpdate (debug menu), blocks the input actions and sets the game state to "career". Does nothing if active is false.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Profile save hook: writes career/general.json (level, startingOptions, boughtStarterVehicle, organizationInteraction, debug window states).

onBeforeSetProfile.desc: Hook called before changing profile: deactivates the career if it is active.

onSerialize.desc: Extension reload hook: deactivates the career and notes reactivate = true if it was active.

onDeserialized.desc: Post-reload hook: reactivates the career (activateCareer(false)) if v.reactivate.

onClientEndMission.desc: End-of-level hook: deactivates the career if the level is west_coast_usa.

levelPath.desc: Path of the level that is ending.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook after a level starts: runs the career's deferred initialization (emits onCareerActive(true, newSave)).

onLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Navigates to "play" exactly once, at the end of the loading screen fade that follows the activation (the router resends the request until the UI confirms).

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Challenge state change hook: blocks the input actions when it stops ("stopped") and unblocks them when it starts ("started").

onVehicleAddedToInventory.desc: Hook for adding a vehicle to the inventory: marks the starter vehicle as bought (immediate save) and unlocks the FIRST_SET_OF_KEYS achievement for an instant purchase at apmStarterVehicles.

onCameraModeChanged.desc: Camera mode change hook: updates the nodegrabber blocking if the career is active.

onGlobalCameraSet.desc: Global camera change hook: updates the nodegrabber blocking.
